name: Bug report
about: Something isn't working the way it should

---

**Which site were you on?**
e.g. chatgpt.com, claude.ai, gemini.google.com, a right-click on another page, etc.

**What did you click, and what happened?**
e.g. "Clicked Argue Back, then The Decay — nothing appeared, spinner stayed forever."

**What did you expect instead?**

**Screenshot or console output**
Open DevTools (F12) → Console tab, and paste any red error text here if there is any.

**Extension version**
Check `chrome://extensions` → Argue Back → version number, or the commit hash if you cloned from source.
